response.overview: Trip.com Customer Service? Step-by-Step Guide for Fast Resolution +1-855-590-0778(US) or+44-204-586-5278[UK] You can contact Trip.com customer service directly at +1-855-590-0778(US) or+44-204-586-5278[UK] (USA/Canada) or via the Trip.com Get in Touch Page to request a supervisor or human escalation for unresolved issues. +1-855-590-0778(US) or+44-204-586-5278[UK] Trip.com does not publish a dedicated, direct "supervisor-only" or secret escalation phone number. Instead, standard customer service lines handle all incoming calls and escalations.
